decisions: Capture source module catalog before moving the semantic snapshot, then build base request from actual context universe and emission metadata.
Refine each emitted module with ordinal-sorted complete stable identities of its actual emitted function set.
Emission-set arithmetic is generated from compiled CSharp policy and preserves five existing production beta keys/fragments.
Transport complete interface/implementation keys as typed unit framing; malformed or mixed keyed streams reject before linking.
